sentences.ar: وفوق كل هاد، بيكي ما عادت تحكي معه.
sentences.en: And on top of all that, Becky no longer spoke to him.

sentences.ar: كانت تمرق جنبه بالمدرسة، وتتطلع لجهة تانية.
sentences.en: She would pass him at school, and look the other way.
And Tom tried everything.
He stood on his head in front of her.
She did not look.
He fought a boy in front of her, and won.
She did not look.

sentences.ar: وبعدين مرضت، وغابت أسبوع، وتوم فكر إنها رح تموت.
sentences.en: And then she fell ill, and was away a week, and Tom thought she would die.

sentences.ar: وما عاد يهتم بالحرب ولا بالقراصنة ولا بأي إشي.
sentences.en: And he no longer cared about war or pirates or anything.

sentences.ar: الخالة بولي خافت عليه، لأنه صار أصفر وساكت.
sentences.en: Aunt Polly worried about him, because he had gone pale and quiet.

sentences.ar: وكانت بتحب الأدوية الجديدة، وبتجرب كل دوا بتسمع عنه.
sentences.en: And she loved new medicines, and tried every remedy she heard of.

sentences.ar: حممته بمي بارد، ولفته بشراشف مبلولة.
sentences.en: She bathed him in cold water, and wrapped him in wet sheets.
And gave him medicines that tasted of fire.
And Tom did not care.

sentences.ar: وبعدين إجت بدوا جديد: مسكن الألم.
sentences.en: And then she came with a new remedy: the pain-killer.
And Tom took the bottle.

sentences.ar: وصار يعطي منه للقطة، بيتر، بالمعلقة.
sentences.en: And began giving it to the cat, Peter, by the spoonful.

sentences.ar: وبيتر طار، وصار يركض بالبيت، ويقلب الكراسي، ويطلع عالحيطان.
sentences.en: And Peter flew, and began racing around the house, overturning chairs, climbing the walls.
And Aunt Polly said: Tom!
What did you do to the cat?
Tom said: I gave her the medicine.
I loved her the way you love me.
And she laughed, and cried, and stopped giving him medicines.
And one day, Becky came back to school.

sentences.ar: توم شافها من بعيد، وقلبه نط.
sentences.en: Tom saw her from afar, and his heart leapt.

sentences.ar: وبلش يلعب، ويصرخ، ويقفز، ويضحك، كله عشانها.
sentences.en: And he began playing, shouting, jumping, laughing, all for her.

sentences.ar: وهي وقفت مع بنت تانية، وتطلعت فيه، وقالت بصوت عالي:
sentences.en: And she stood with another girl, looked at him, and said out loud:
Some people think they are important.

sentences.ar: بيعملوا أي إشي عشان الناس تتطلع فيهم.
sentences.en: They do anything so people will look at them.

sentences.ar: وتوم وقف مكانه، وصار وجهه أحمر.
sentences.en: And Tom stood where he was, and his face went red.
And he walked off, saying to himself: that is it.
No one loves me.
I will become a pirate.
A pirate.

sentences.ar: يعني سفينة سودا، وعلم أسود، وسيف، وناس بتخاف لما تسمع اسمه.
sentences.en: That meant a black ship, a black flag, a sword, and people afraid when they heard his name.

sentences.ar: وبعدين بيرجع للقرية، بعد سنين، بتياب سودا.
sentences.en: And then he would come back to the village, after years, in black clothes.
And Becky would see him and be sorry.

sentences.ar: راح وحكى مع جو هاربر، صاحبه.
sentences.en: He went and talked to Joe Harper, his friend.

sentences.ar: أمه كانت ضربته على إشي ما عمله.
sentences.en: His mother had beaten him for something he had not done.
And Joe said: I am with you.

sentences.ar: وراحوا عند هَك، وهَك قال: ليش لا؟
sentences.en: And they went to Huck, and Huck said: why not?

sentences.ar: وقرروا يهربوا بنص الليل، على جزيرة جاكسون بالنهر.
sentences.en: And they decided to run away at midnight, to Jackson's Island in the river.
And become pirates.
